contract: one authored script read whole with ass_read_memory, or one stream fixture run on a track from ass_new_track as ass-parse-chunks runs it (codec private, packets through ass_process_chunk with ReadOrder deduplication, flushes and ass_prune_events), configured as a player embeds libass 0.17.5: a library with font extraction on and the fixture's font files given to ass_add_font in order, a renderer with frame and storage size set (the storage smaller than the frame: 1280x720 on 1920x1080, and 720x576 on 1280x720, whose pixel aspect is not 1), ASS_HINTING_NONE, and ass_set_fonts with the fixture's default font file and family and ASS_FONTPROVIDER_NONE
frames rendered with ass_render_frame at the fixture's times: a whole script's ;@frames, a stream's @frames commands where they stand among its packets and prunes

every frame folds its time and image count, then every image its type, position, width, height and colour and every row of its alpha bytes, in libass's list order; packets count images and bytes their alpha bytes
the fixture and its fonts are read before each timed and memory operation, which creates the library and renderer, reads the script or runs the stream and renders every frame
pending_module_requirements: the renderer: font selection and fallback, shaping, layout, the glyph and bitmap pipeline and the image list

triergon-shape's open shape-libass cases, which block qualifying triergon-ass: the default-load advances FreeType's auto-hinter sets (DejaVuMathTeXGyre, authored-cmap-formats and six Noto Emoji variants)

triergon-shape's open shape-libass case authored-cff-features-otf-latn-libass, which blocks qualifying triergon-ass: fallback mark positioning in a CFF font without GPOS reads FreeType's hinted glyph extents
